body.name: Component total-effect set
body.construction: For \(E\in\mathfrak S_p\) and \(\Sigma\in\mathbb S^p_{++}\), compute the explicit block-constrained map \(L_D(\Sigma)\) from \(\texttt{def:off-model-block-ls}\) for every \(D\in\mathcal R(E)\). Define \(g_D(\Sigma)=(((I_p-L_D(\Sigma))^{-1})_{ya})_{(a,y)\in\mathcal Q}\) and \[\mathcal T_E(\Sigma)=\{g_D(\Sigma):D\in\mathcal R(E)\}.\] Because \(G_D\) is acyclic, \(I_p-L_D(\Sigma)\) is invertible. Each \(g_D\) is rational and smooth on \(\mathbb S^p_{++}\), and \(\mathrm Dg_D(\Sigma)\) is defined throughout that cone. The causal target is the specialization \(\mathcal T_C(\Sigma)\) for \(\Sigma\in\mathcal M(C)\).
